This map shows the major areas of Computer Engineering and one sensible order for learning them. It is a map, not a checklist. Your class may move between areas as projects and equipment become available.

## Learning map

::: {.ter-path-grid}
::: {.ter-path-card}
### 1. Foundations and measurement

Read measurements, use units, estimate, and write very large or small values clearly.

[Open Foundations](../01-number-systems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 2. Basic electricity

Build a working model of charge, voltage, current, resistance, power, energy, opens, and shorts.

[Open Basic Electricity](../02-basic-electronics/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 3. DC circuits

Calculate and check series, parallel, mixed, and Kirchhoff circuit networks.

[Open Circuit Analysis](../circuits/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 4. Measurement and circuit building

Move from a schematic to a simulation or breadboard, then compare predictions with measurements.

[Find labs and activities](../electronics-library/index.qmd#labs-and-assignments)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 5. Electronic components

Explore resistors, switches, diodes, capacitors, transistors, sensors, motors, relays, and useful circuits.

[Browse component resources](../electronics-library/index.qmd#components-and-applied-circuits)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 6. Digital logic

Use binary states, stable inputs, gates, truth tables, and simple digital decisions.

[Open Digital Logic](../03-digital-logic-inputs/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 7. Fabrication and PCB workflow

Turn tested designs into physical parts, soldered circuits, boards, or enclosures.

[Open Design &amp; Fabrication](../../design-fabrication/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 8. Computer systems

Identify parts, understand power, start a computer, install an operating system, upgrade it, and test it.

[Open Computer Systems](../computer-systems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 9. Linux, operating systems and networking

Install Linux, use the desktop and terminal, inspect hardware, and diagnose connections.

[Open Linux &amp; Operating Systems](../linux-operating-systems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 10. Programming

Turn a process into clear steps, code, tests, and useful output.

[Explore programming in the engineering track](../engineering-preparation-track/index.qmd#boolean-logic-algorithms-and-state-machines)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 11. Microcontrollers

Connect code to protected inputs, sensors, outputs, timing, communication, and actuators.

[Open Physical Computing](../04-microcontrollers/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 12. Systems administration and networks

Work with addresses, services, users, permissions, remote access, and troubleshooting.

[Open Networking Diagnosis](../linux-operating-systems/networking-diagnosis.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 13. Data and machine learning

Collect useful data, graph it, test models, and explain what the evidence can and cannot show.

[Open the data and modelling track](../engineering-preparation-track/index.qmd#curve-fitting-regression-and-machine-learning)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 14. Applied AI

Explore small, testable uses of artificial intelligence while checking sources, privacy, limits, and results.

[Start with data and model evaluation](../engineering-preparation-track/index.qmd#curve-fitting-regression-and-machine-learning)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 15. Projects and culminating work

Combine design, building, code, measurement, testing, revision, and communication in a useful project.

[Explore projects](../electronics-library/projects/index.qmd)
:::
:::
